evidence: "Johnson's rule"; "Group 1: p1 <= p2, sort by p1 ascending"; "Group 2: p1 > p2, sort by p2 descending"; "Johnson's rule comparison"
affordance_in_statement: A bakery must complete each order through "exactly two workstations"; every order is processed in the oven first and then at the icing station; "both workstations process the orders in the same chosen sequence"; minimize the time at which the "last" order finishes.
removal_suggestion: Do not present the task as a standard two-machine permutation flow shop. Add a genuinely order-dependent third processing stage or another nonuniform precedence/setup condition, while deriving its duration from the existing two input values so the input and output formats remain unchanged.
